_note: Academy offers at 16. Each type trades something. coaching = training skill-gain multiplier; pathway = base chance of first-team football; patience = how hard bad games hit manager approval (higher = harsher); approval = starting manager approval. Club pools: 'high' if your scout rating (average best drill score out of 5) is 2.5 or more, 'low' otherwise.

elite.label: Elite academy
elite.catch: Crowded pathway, likely loans, little patience
pitch: "We've produced more internationals than you've had hot dinners. Mostly because we feed them salad."
"Our under-18s have a sports scientist, a chef and a man whose only job is folding towels. You'll love it."

pathway.label: Pathway club
pathway.strength: Clear route to the first team
pitch: "Play well and you'll be on the bench by October. Play badly and you'll be on the bench by October anyway, because we've only got fourteen fit players."
"Three of our first team came through the academy. A fourth came through the car park, but that's another story."

money.label: Money club
money.catch: Pressure from day one, agent sharks circle
pitch: "Our owners are very ambitious. And very famous. There may be cameras. Do you have a good side?"
"Here's fifteen grand. Don't ask where it's from. It's from the owners. Who you mustn't ask about."

family.label: Family club
family.strength: Security, housing, patience with bad behaviour
family.catch: Slow progress, may cap your ceiling
pitch: "You'll lodge with Mrs Pemberton. She's eighty-one, makes a cracking shepherd's pie, and once broke a burglar's nose with a skillet."
"Everyone here looks out for each other. The tea lady's been here since 1974. She will know if you've skipped training."
